# Aiscern

> Free multi-modal AI content detection for text, image, audio, and video. Built with ensemble-based analysis and published accuracy benchmarks.

## About

Aiscern is a free AI detection platform built by Anas Ali in Mandi Bahauddin, Pakistan. It detects AI-generated content across text, images, audio, and video using ensemble machine learning models, with published accuracy benchmarks.
